name: Tonari no Oppai Wakaoku-sama Ayame-san
original_name: 隣のおっぱい若奥様 あやめさん
source:
One summer vacation day a large bra blew into my bedroom.
There was no doubt, the I-cup treasure had flown off the neighbor's veranda.
My neighbor... I thought of her magnificent bust every day on the way to school... her smile.
"I get to talk to her," I thought giddily, brassiere in hand, as I approached her door...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115483.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一个暑假的一天，一件大胸罩被风吹进了我的卧室。
毫无疑问，I罩杯的宝贝是从邻居的阳台上飞下来的。
我的邻居……我每天在上学的路上都会想起她那宏伟的胸像……她的微笑。
“我可以和她说话，”当我走近她的门时，我手里拿着胸罩，头晕目眩地想……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115483.html]DLsite English[/url]]
